emulation: real hosting: the sites were published on the real origins (recorded here as <course-domain>), with their real DNS, certificates and host headers
emulated: a "desktop session" is one headless browser process on a persistent profile (Playwright launchPersistentContext, then close); sessions were seconds apart; not a real user's browser restart
remote mode ran sessions s1 and s2 only and kept no server request log; the offline session and the hostile embedder need the local stand-in
Playwright 1.63.0 defaults changed back toward the shipped browsers as in the local run (meta.json, firefox-pref.txt)

configs.label: same-site, plain iframe: the hosting plan
cross-site, plain iframe: another static host on its own domain

sessions_note: Each engine and configuration ran three browser sessions on one fresh persistent profile: s1 online and cold (consent, cache fill, run, probes, then the top-navigation probe last); s2 online after a restart (cache state read before any request, run without consent, probes, first-party view of the instrument origin); s3 after a restart with the instrument hostname answering 503 to every request (run without consent, then evict).

values.engine_first_load_note: the six engine files as served by the stand-in server, uncompressed; compressed first-load sizes on real devices are W0-S02's RUN-phone-pyodide

notes: Question: does the instrument origin work on its own custom subdomain, with Z3 running cross-origin and the parent's storage unreadable in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit, and do the framed origin's Cache API and service worker persist across desktop sessions under storage partitioning?

Answer on the real hosts: yes in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit, configurations A (plain iframe) and B (sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin"), sessions s1 and s2: 36 of 36 checks pass. The offline session and the hostile embedder ran only in the local stand-in, RUN-origin-subdomain.
Model values are not canonical: each run checks the witness against the property (witness_ok) rather than matching the printed model.

Hosting: the site origin was published from praveer13/statespace (branch gh-pages) and the instrument origin from praveer13/statespace-instruments, each on its own subdomain under the owner's domain on GitHub Pages; hostnames are recorded as <course-domain>. The spike pages were removed from the site root after the run.
Companion of RUN-origin-subdomain (the local stand-in run of the same harness, with the offline session and the hostile embedder).
